info.name: Elevon POS - FBR DI sandbox scenarios (production-token sign-off)
info.description: One request per scenario FBR assigned to the store's sandbox profile, so each can be posted once to turn 'Pending' into 'Successful' before IRIS issues the production token. Sale types, rate descriptions and SRO schedule/item values were read from PRAL's reference lists (transtypecode, SaleTypeToRate, SroSchedule, SROItem) on 2026-10-12 and every body except SN001 validated 00 that day. Set token, seller_* and buyer_* in a Postman ENVIRONMENT (template in this folder), never in this file. Run folder 1 (validate) first, then folder 2 (post). Sandbox-only: every URL ends in _sb. SN002 is already Successful on the profile and lives in the main collection.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('token') && !pm.collectionVariables.get('token')) { console.warn('No token set: create a Postman environment with token = your IRIS sandbox bearer token.'); }

variable.description: Override in an environment. IRIS sandbox bearer token.
NTN digits only, without the check digit (3792106-1 → 3792106)
SN001 only: a sales-tax-registered NTN other than the seller's (8951943-3 → 8951943). The seller's own NTN is refused with 0058, a made-up one with 0205.

item.name: SN001. Goods at standard rate to a REGISTERED buyer

request.description: buyer_ntn must be a sales-tax-registered NTN other than the seller's (0058 for the seller's own, 0205 for a made-up one). Validated 00 on 2026-10-12 with the buyer in the collection variables.

item.name: SN017. Goods with FED charged in sales-tax mode (petroleum, 18% + Rs 80/L)

request.description: transTypeId 21 → rate 1043 '18% and Rs. 80 per Liter'. PRAL accepts only an HS code it maps to this sale type (2710.1240 / 2710.1250 / 2710.1942; anything else is 0052) and computes the tax as 18% of fixedNotifiedValueOrRetailPrice plus Rs 80 per litre, so that field must be set: 10 L, value 1,000, notified 2,000 → tax 360 + 800 = 1,160. Validated 00 on 2026-10-12.
